# See Job Run

> See Job Run is construction management software for independent general contractors and small crews. Jobs, scheduling, tasks, time tracking, job-site photos, documents, budgets, invoices, change orders and e-signatures are in one app that works on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web, in English and Spanish. Plans start at $69/month with every feature included, and every plan starts with a 60-day free trial (no credit card).

## Who it's for
Small and independent general contractors, remodelers and custom-home builders who run their own crews and subcontractors.

## What it does
- **Jobs & leads**: track every lead and job, with its contacts, documents, photos and materials.
- **Scheduling**: drag-and-drop job schedule, master calendar, appointments and daily logs.
- **Tasks**: assign tasks to employees and subcontractors and see them get done.
- **Time tracking**: crew time cards against jobs.
- **Money records**: estimates, budgets (with Excel export), invoices and change orders. See Job Run records job payments; it does not process them.
- **E-signatures**: send documents for signature and keep the signed copy with the job.
- **Subcontractor bid requests**: send bid requests to subcontractors and collect their bids in the app.
- **People**: employees, free subcontractor access, a free client portal, chat, push and email alerts.
- **English & Spanish**: each person picks a language; typed notes, tasks and updates translate automatically.

## Pricing (USD, per month)
- **Starter — $69**: 1–3 employees.
- **Team — $99**: up to 5 employees.
- **Crew — $129**: up to 10 employees.
- **+$15 per employee** over 10.
- Every feature on every plan. Subcontractors and clients are always free.
- 60-day free trial, no credit card.

## Platforms
iPhone, iPad, Android and desktop web browsers. On a phone it installs from the browser to the home screen.
